title: 第135章 父亲你有这精力
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

基里曼从飞行器里跨出来，先脚步一步扫视完了战场。

原体拥有原体级视觉。

阿斯塔特的视野比凡人要灵敏无数倍，原体的视野比阿斯塔特还要灵敏无数倍，超不讲道理，反正大就是棒，大就是强。

一踏出舱门就看到整片战场都在发光。

基里曼顿了一下。

从地面到天空，从前线到后方，金色光芒浓烈到几乎具有实感，覆盖着每一寸土地，金光平铺在岩壳上翻涌，把普兰迪姆原本灰黑焦枯的地面染成了一片金色的浅滩。

整个正面战场。

从头到尾。

所有极限战士脚下踩着的区域。

全部被金光铺满。

基里曼：“……？”

他知道他抢来了一个父亲的疑似活圣人，但没想到场面会这么夸张。

这铺满全场的金光是怎么回事？

孩子们怎么一个都没死？

他走出白烟缭绕的空降舱范围，踏进那片金色光芒的边界。

身体传来轻微的温热感，像幼时赤脚踩在被太阳晒了一天的砂岩上，连他身上一直被混沌剧毒腐蚀的痛苦都减轻了几分。

完全光明的力量。

是活圣人的治愈光环。

他的子嗣们的阵线在稳步推进，战术小队保持标准间距，重火力小队交替掩护，一连的终结者在左翼开路，三连的突击队在右侧收割，一切看起来非常正常，非常符合极限战士的战术手册，非常训练有素。

没有伤员，没有尸体。

基里曼：“……”

这怎么得了啊？

与恶魔前锋接火，火力密度极高，有至少上百头嗜血狂魔在冲击阵线。

按照正常的战损估算，这种强度的接火至少会出现两位数伤亡。

但所有战士都站着，没有人倒下，连一个包扎止血的动作都没有出现。

活圣人这种东西这么厉害吗？？？在战场上的作用比他们原体还强？？？

摄政王面甲后面的表情空白了一瞬。

但他还是撑住了气势，没有露怯。

孩子们面前，就算感觉亲爹降临了也……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Guilliman stepped out of the aircraft and scanned the battlefield one step at a time.

The Primarch possesses Primarch-level vision.

The vision of the Astartes is countless times more sensitive than that of mortals, and the vision of the original body is countless times more sensitive than that of the Astartes. It is so unreasonable. Anyway, big is great, and big is strong.

As soon as I stepped out of the hatch, I saw that the entire battlefield was glowing.

Guilliman paused.

From the ground to the sky, from the front line to the rear, the golden light was so intense that it was almost real, covering every inch of the land. The golden light spread flatly on the rock shell and dyed the originally gray and black parched ground of Plantium into a golden shoal.

The entire frontal battlefield.

From start to finish.

The area where all the Ultramarines step on.

Everything is covered with golden light.

Guilliman: "...?"

He knew that he had robbed a suspected living saint of his father, but he did not expect that the scene would be so exaggerated.

What's going on with this golden light that covers the whole place?

How come none of the children died?

He walked out of the range of the white smoke-filled drop pod and stepped into the border of golden light.

A slight feeling of warmth came from his body, like when he was a child stepping barefoot on sandstone that had been exposed to the sun for a day. Even the pain that had been corroded by the poison of chaos on his body was relieved a bit.

The power of total light.

It is the healing aura of a living saint.

The front line of his heirs is advancing steadily, with the tactical teams maintaining standard spacing, the heavy firepower teams alternately covering, the terminators of the first company are opening the way on the left, and the commandos of the third company are harvesting on the right. Everything looks very normal, very consistent with the Ultramarines tactical manual, and very well-trained.

No wounded, no bodies.

Guilliman: "..."

How can this happen?

Engaging with the demon front line, the firepower density was extremely high, with at least hundreds of bloodthirsty demons attacking the front line.

According to normal battle damage estimates, a firefight of this intensity would result in at least double-digit casualties.

But all the soldiers stood, no one fell down, and not even a bandage was made to stop the bleeding.

Is such a thing as a living saint so powerful???Is it more effective on the battlefield than their original body???

The expression behind the Regent's visor went blank for a moment.

But he still maintained his momentum and did not show any timidity.

In front of the children, even if I feel like my biological father has arrived...
